<thought>Three carbon signals appear in the aromatic region (≈120–160 ppm): 161.40, 143.85, and 130.30 ppm. Such a pattern (three distinct aromatic signals) is characteristic of a symmetric 1,3,5‑trisubstituted benzene ring, which contains six aromatic carbon atoms. Therefore the molecule has six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
